I am a poor man here in Amhara, renting this small piece of land, only a tenth and a bit of a hectare. Beans are good for me because they do not need much fertilizer like teff or maize — the crop itself feeds the soil. I have no money for chemicals and I did not go to school, so I trust the seed I saved from last year and the manure from my few animals. My wife and I will work the plot ourselves; for such a small piece I do not need to pay anyone, maybe only a neighbor for a day at weeding if the rains are heavy.
